on_screen_text.text: Rep. Khanna on the release of the Epstein files:
REPS. KHANNA & MASSIE HOLD A NEWS CONFERENCE ON EPSTEIN FILES
THERE IS SOMETHING THAT IS ROTTEN IN WASHINGTON.
LESS THAN 1% OF THESE FILES HAVE BEEN RELEASED.
WE ARE DEMANDING TODAY ON THE DISCHARGE PETITION THAT ALL OF THE FILES BE RELEASED.

WE KNOW WE HAVE 212 DEMOCRATS AND WE HAVE FOUR REPUBLICANS, COURAGEOUS REPUBLICANS LIKE THOMAS MASSIE, NANCY MACE, WHO WAS SO EMOTIONAL YESTERDAY AFTER TALKING TO THE SURVIVORS, CONGRESSWOMAN BOEBERT AND CONGRESSWOMAN MARJORIE TAYLOR GREENE.
WE NEED JUST TWO MORE SIGNATURES TO FORCE THE RELEASE.

spoken_summary: Rep. Ro Khanna speaks at a press conference, stating that 'there is something that is rotten in Washington' because less than 1% of the files related to Jeffrey Epstein have been released. He announces that they are using a discharge petition to demand the release of all the files. Khanna states they have the support of 212 Democrats and four Republicans—Thomas Massie, Nancy Mace, Lauren Boebert, and Marjorie Taylor Greene—and need just two more signatures to succeed.
audio_music: Clear audio of a person speaking at an outdoor press conference, with ambient background noise of a crowd. There is no music.
editing_pacing: A single, static shot from a press conference. Large, white caption text appears on screen, synchronized with the speaker's words.
central_claim: A bipartisan group in Congress is only two signatures away from forcing the full release of the Jeffrey Epstein files, which are being unjustly withheld.
intended_effect: To generate public pressure on members of Congress to sign the discharge petition and to foster a sense of outrage over the lack of transparency.
uncertainty_flags: The speaker says 'Congresswoman Balbert', which is almost certainly a mispronunciation or transcription error for 'Lauren Boebert'.
